$comment: Accepted high/critical npm audit advisories (production deps). Each entry needs a reason, owner and expiry; an expired entry fails CI. Triage: 2026-11-08, PR aykuttepe/betguess#1.

server.reason: whatsapp-web.js -> puppeteer -> @puppeteer/browsers. Only extracts the Chromium archive downloaded from Google's CDN at install time; never handles user-supplied archives. No fixed release exists.

whatsapp-web.js -> puppeteer -> proxy-agent -> get-uri. Only used for ftp:// proxy/PAC URLs during browser download; no FTP proxy is configured. Every 5.x release is affected and get-uri still requires ^5.
whatsapp-web.js -> puppeteer -> chromium-bidi. Validates WebDriver BiDi messages from the local Chromium process only; puppeteer uses CDP by default. Fix needs zod 4 (major), pinned by chromium-bidi.

client.reason: Framework/SSR/RSC-mode advisories; the app is a client-only SPA using <BrowserRouter>. A fix exists within ^7.13.1 (7.18.2+); short expiry until the Codex-owned update lands.
